title: OrganizationChange
description: Represents a change in an organization within Producerflow

organization_id.description: Always present. Unique identifier for the organization

name.description: Always present. Display name of the organization

external_id.description: Always present if filled in by tenant. External identifier for the organization

email.description: Always present if filled in by tenant. Contact email address of the organization

is_wholesaler.description: Present when true. Whether the organization is a wholesaler
